candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Removal of Esri Image Services - WCS replacement guidance
verified_facts: Persistent LIDAR Composite DTM1m WCS endpoint is documented without a year suffix.
WCS services are supported at OGC version 2.0.1.
WCS provides raw elevation pixel data.
WCS GeoTIFF NoData is documented as approximately -3.4028235e+38.
semantic_limits: A persistent current endpoint does not imply that all source observations were captured in the current year.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
verified_facts: The live metadata describes the composite as produced in 2022.
Source surveys span 6 June 2000 through 2 April 2022.
Repeat-survey selection uses the newest best-resolution data available to the composite.
CRS is EPSG:27700 and vertical accuracy is +/-15cm RMSE.
semantic_limits: The live metadata page is current service metadata, not proof of a 2026 ground observation at any target parcel.

candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: Time-stamped DTM archive records survey dates and varying resolutions.
Elevations are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and aligned to the OS Grid.
Transformation is specific to survey time period and catalogue metadata should be consulted for date/resolution/transform/geoid.
semantic_limits: A time-stamped archive record near a target is lineage evidence and is not automatically the exact composite pixel source.

candidates.name: 012_sample_ea_dtm1m_polygons.py
verified_facts: Sampler uses WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage.
Sampler requests GeoTIFF with subsetting/output CRS EPSG:27700.
Sampler uses all_touched=False and records GeoTIFF SHA-256.
Sampler rejects XML/error responses and extreme negative NoData values.
semantic_limits: Static code validation is not runtime execution and does not prove current WCS bytes were retrieved in this session.
